name: Bedtime Routine
description: A gentle bedtime story following your baby's nightly routine

pages.title: Bath Time
pages.text: Splish, splash! Little [Baby Name] loves bath time. The warm water feels so nice, and the bubbles dance and pop. [Baby Name] giggles as tiny rubber ducks float by. Clean and cozy, it's time for the next adventure!

pages.title: Pajama Time
pages.text: Now it's time for the softest, coziest pajamas! [Baby Name] stretches little arms up high as [Parent Name] helps with the buttons. The pajamas have the sweetest pattern, perfect for a night full of wonderful dreams.

pages.title: Family Cuddle
pages.text: The best part of the evening is cuddle time! [Baby Name] snuggles close with [Parent Name], feeling warm and safe. Little arms wrap around for the biggest hug. Love fills the room like a cozy blanket.

pages.title: Story Time
pages.text: With a favorite book in hand, [Baby Name] listens to magical tales of faraway lands. Each page brings new wonders and adventures. [Baby Name]'s eyes grow wide with amazement at every turn of the page.

pages.title: Lullaby Time
pages.text: A gentle song fills the air as [Parent Name] hums a sweet lullaby. The melody dances through the room like fireflies in summer. [Baby Name]'s eyes begin to feel heavy, filled with peaceful dreams waiting to begin.

pages.title: Goodnight Kiss
pages.text: One sweet kiss on [Baby Name]'s forehead, then another on each cheek. 'Goodnight, little one,' whispers [Parent Name] softly. The nightlight glows warmly, keeping watch through the night.

pages.title: Sweet Dreams
pages.text: And now, dear [Baby Name] drifts off to dreamland, where unicorns play and stars sing lullabies. Tomorrow brings new adventures, but for now, sleep tight, little one. Sweet dreams until morning light.
